status: Independent CPU and source review passed; final browser, visual and release acceptance are separate
reviewScope: Read the complete corridor source and its guarded renderer hooks
Read integrated installation, full-lap rendering, pit-shell synchronisation, shadow drawing and teardown wrappers
Independently reran the actual-source 48-check regression on an immutable copy of the integrated candidate

resolvedFindings.finding: A second failure during buffer rollback could otherwise leave mixed payloads available to draw.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Fatal rollback records a diagnostic, marks the scene lost, tears down to the original flat circuit and clears scene ownership; persistent JS and GL error cases pass.

resolvedFindings.finding: The inherited full-lap wrapper retains the prior scene while ensuring detail and may call the legacy renderer after fatal teardown.
resolvedFindings.resolution: The outer guard suppresses only a fresh diagnosed fatal teardown within that render call; the equivalent null-scene legacy path and unrelated-error propagation both pass.

sourceReview: Corrected boundaries derive from the existing measured-width centreline; source contour and centreline arrays remain intact.
Deck, skirt, legacy barrier, both edge lines, four physical fence batches and owned banner vertices switch through the ten existing buffer families.
Enhanced surface geometry stages on the same corrected loops with zero schematic front offset; source default emitters retain their previous output.
Only tagged existing banner vertices and label transforms move. Enhanced sign meshes receive temporary corrected metadata, then original scene references are restored.
Original buffer handles are retained; corrected index and instance counts apply through the same draw functions used by the shadow pass. Shadow caches invalidate on both transitions.
Detail-off restores exact original payloads. Teardown returns draw ownership to the original batches; no added GPU objects require separate deletion.
The architecture layout includes its two-value local-facade attribute; the final integrated body matches the reviewed module.
Final pit and corridor wrappers compose around the existing enhanced installer and disposer; source anchors and nominal pit envelopes are retained.
limits: This review ran no GPU browser and establishes no rendering quality or device frame-rate claim.
The 48-check camera matrix covers settled road-camera poses; transition trajectories are audited separately.
Existing tyre stacks, tyre belts and braking boards retain original source anchors outside the narrowed corridor. Their final appearance requires the integrated visual review.
Widths come from the existing 2022 aerial-derived carriageway profile. The corrected barriers are illustrative, not surveyed race-barrier alignment.
Photograph-informed facades and pit structures retain nominal source envelopes; they do not establish surveyed heights or landmark identity.
The separate 30-image visual794_detail_review.json describes the earlier pre-corridor candidate and is not final-corridor visual acceptance.
